senses.gloss:
r. 6th cl. (रिशति)
To hurt, to injure, to kill or attempt to kill.

r. 1st cl. (रेषति) r. 4th cl. (रिष्यति)
To hurt, to kill, or attempt to kill.
r. 9th cl. (रिष्णाति)
To separate, to depart.

m. (-श्यः)
A deer.
E.
रिश to hurt, aff. क्यप्.

m. (-ष्यः)
A deer.
E.
रिष to hurt, to be hurt, aff. क्यप्.

n. (-षिः)
A saint.
E.
रि substituted for ऋ; see ऋषि.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Hurt, injured.
2 Unlucky.
3 Lucky.
n. (-ष्टं)
1 Happiness, prosperity.
2 Good luck, fortune.
3 Bad luck, ill fortune.
4 Destruction, loss, privation.
5 Sin.
m. (-ष्टः)
1 A sword.
2 The soap plant.
3 A demon, destroyed by VIṢṆU.
E.
रिष to hurt or injure, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
The soap-berry plant, (Sapindus of several species.)
E.
रिष्ट the same, कन् added.

m. (-ष्टिः)
A sword.
f. (-ष्टिः)
Prosperity, good fortune.
E.
रिष to hurt, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-ष्वः-ष्वा-ष्वं)
Mischievous, injurious.
E.
रिष to hurt, Uṇādi aff. वन्, form irr.
